verdict.rationale: Fern ships an official CLI that can initialize projects, validate API definitions, and publish documentation and SDKs, which makes the core workflow scriptable without a UI (fern-docs-1, fern-probe-5). Fern Agent can also run on a schedule and open pull requests unattended (fern-docs-8), and a self-hosted container resolves environment variables per deployment (fern-docs-11). Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD documentation (e.g. GitHub Actions or pipeline examples), non-interactive auth/token guidance for CI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless CI usage.
